acceptanceCriteria: Real-DB concurrency check of the CacheLock-serialized same-key retry (unit coverage currently mocks the lock through — phase-01 report 2026-09-14 07:00): concurrent same-key requests produce exactly one operation outcome
Test same-key retries/concurrent requests: no duplicate installs and no duplicate seeds
Async post-install completion, registration failure and partial results behave per the landed per-step capture (retry re-runs only failed/pending steps; succeeded steps returned as-is)

Do not redo: result persistence stays via KeyValuePairService (workspace-scoped template-operation:<key> keys); ApplyWorkspaceTemplateInput is extended additively, never replaced; legacy applyWorkspaceTemplate GraphQL shape untouched
